system.description:
These grenades explode in a burst of compressed air, and are most often used for subduing groups with non-lethal force.

A creature damaged by this attack must make a Resilience check of 4:X where X is the number of successes on the attack. If they fail, they are knocked Prone.

If a creature would start Dying or otherwise be defeated by this attack, it is knocked unconscious instead.
